scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings lining both sides, featuring a mix of residential and commercial properties. The street is relatively empty, with only a few pedestrians strolling along the sidewalk and a few cars parked along the curb. The sky is overcast, casting a soft, diffused light over the scene. The buildings are a mix of old and new, with some featuring ornate facades and others displaying more modern designs. The street itself is paved with asphalt, with a central median separating the two lanes of traffic. A few trees and greenery are scattered throughout the area, adding a touch of natural beauty to the otherwise urban landscape. In the distance, a large billboard stands atop one of the taller buildings, its digital display showing a static message or advertisement. Overall, the scene exudes a sense of calm and tranquility, despite being located in the heart of a bustling city.
